Os erros foram convertidos para 1σ absol: Uncertainties were converted to absolute 1σ before calculation.
As incertezas das idades da amostra são: Sample age uncertainties are quoted at 2σ and include analytical uncertainty only, without decay constant or calibration uncertainties (the x ± y level of Horstwood et al., 2016).
A discordância foi calculada como 100 ×: Discordance was calculated as 100 × (1 − t206/238 / t207/206).
A idade da amostra foi calculada como mé: The sample age was calculated as an inverse-variance weighted mean, with the MSWD and the chi-square p-value as measures of homogeneity (Wendt and Carl, 1991).
A idade concórdia foi calculada pelo mét: The concordia age was calculated following Ludwig (1998).
Os interceptos da discórdia foram obtido: Discordia intercepts were obtained by linear regression with correlated errors (York et al., 2004) in Wetherill space.
As populações de idade foram separadas p: Age populations were separated at the minima of the kernel density estimate (KDE) of the ages (Vermeesch, 2012).
O Pb comum foi corrigido pelo 204Pb, com: Common Pb was corrected using 204Pb and the Stacey and Kramers (1975) model composition at the age of each grain, calculated iteratively (Williams, 1998).
O Pb comum foi corrigido pelo 204Pb com: Common Pb was corrected using 204Pb and the Canyon Diablo composition (Tatsumoto et al., 1973; Williams, 1998).
Foi usado o modelo de efeitos aleatórios: A random-effects model was used, which estimates the geological dispersion in excess of the analytical uncertainty (Vermeesch, 2018a).
Outliers foram rejeitados pelo critério: Outliers were rejected with a generalised Chauvenet criterion (Vermeesch, 2018a).
As razões 232Th/204Pb e 208Pb/204Pb fora: The 232Th/204Pb and 208Pb/204Pb ratios were regressed by least squares with correlated errors (York et al., 2004) using {sw}. The age was calculated from the isochron slope with the 232Th decay constant of Le Roux and Glendenin (1963): {idade}.
As razões 206Pb/204Pb e 207Pb/204Pb fora: The 206Pb/204Pb and 207Pb/204Pb ratios were regressed as an inverse isochron (204Pb/206Pb vs 207Pb/206Pb) with correlated errors (York et al., 2004) using {sw}, as in IsoplotR (Vermeesch, 2018a). The Pb-Pb age was calculated from the radiogenic 207Pb/206Pb intercept with the decay constants of Jaffey et al. (1971) and 238U/235U = {razao} (Hiess et al., 2012): {idade}.
As razões isotópicas 207Pb/235U e 206Pb/: The 207Pb/235U and 206Pb/238U ratios and error correlations (rho) reported by the laboratory were processed with {sw}, whose calculations reproduce those of IsoplotR (Vermeesch, 2018a).
As idades foram calculadas com as consta: Ages were calculated with the decay constants of Jaffey et al. (1971) and a 238U/235U ratio of {razao} (Hiess et al., 2012).
Como idade de cada grão foi usada a idad: The 206Pb/238U age was used for grains younger than {corte} Ma and the 207Pb/206Pb age for older grains (Gehrels, 2014).
As razões isotópicas 238U/206Pb e 207Pb/: The 238U/206Pb and 207Pb/206Pb ratios and error correlations (rho) reported by the laboratory were processed with {sw}, whose calculations reproduce those of IsoplotR (Vermeesch, 2018a).
As idades por grão fornecidas pelo labor: The single-grain ages reported by the laboratory were processed with {sw}, whose calculations reproduce those of IsoplotR (Vermeesch, 2018a).
Grãos com discordância acima de {disc} %: Grains more than {disc} % discordant were retained in the sample age calculations (Spencer et al., 2016).
Grains more than {disc} % discordant were excluded from the sample age calculations (Spencer et al., 2016).

Uma amostra por arquivo. Se o laboratóri: One sample per file. If the laboratory sent several samples, make one file for each.
O cabeçalho ocupa uma única linha, logo: The header takes up a single row, directly above the data. Do not merge cells or put the unit on a second row: write the unit in the column name itself, as in "± 2σ (%)".
Uma linha por análise, sem linhas em bra: One row per analysis, with no blank rows in between and no notes below the table.
Cada coluna de erro fica logo à direita: Each error column sits immediately to the right of the value it refers to. The error's name says whether it is 1σ or 2σ and includes "%" if it is relative; without "%", the error is absolute.
rho é a correlação entre os erros de 207: rho is the correlation between the errors of 207Pb/235U and 206Pb/238U. Without this column, Zircon uses rho = 0 and warns you.
Para dados de Tera-Wasserburg, troque as: For Tera-Wasserburg data, replace the ratios with 238U/206Pb, its error, 207Pb/206Pb, its error and rho.
Se você só tem idades (sem razões), use: If you only have ages (no ratios), use the columns Sample, Analysis, Age (Ma) and ± 2σ (Ma).
Colunas a mais (U, Th, Pb, Th/U, idades: Extra columns (U, Th, Pb, Th/U, ages calculated by the laboratory) can stay, as long as they are to the right of the ratios. Zircon ignores the ones it does not recognise.
Grãos que você decidiu excluir saem dest: Grains you have decided to exclude come out of this sheet (keep them on another sheet, with the reason). Discordant grains do not need to be removed: Zircon separates them using the discordance limit you choose in the panel.
Os números ficam como números, não como: Numbers stay as numbers, not text. Decimal comma or point, either is fine, but use the same throughout the spreadsheet.
Ao importar, o Zircon mostra como reconh: When importing, Zircon shows how it recognised each column. Check this before continuing.
